# uplapse_locations (Data Source)

Cities monitors can be checked from. Use their `id` in `uplapse_monitor.locations`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every location.
data "uplapse_locations" "all" {}

# Cities in one country, from AWS and Azure only.
data "uplapse_locations" "germany" {
  country   = "Germany"
  providers = ["aws", "azure"]
}

output "location_ids" {
  value = { for l in data.uplapse_locations.all.locations : "${l.name}, ${l.country}" => l.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `continent` (String) Only cities on this continent (case-insensitive, e.g. `Europe`).
- `country` (String) Only cities in this country (case-insensitive country name, e.g. `Germany`).
- `providers` (List of String) Only cities served by these clouds (`aws`, `gcp`, `azure`). Defaults to all three.

### Read-Only

- `locations` (Attributes List) Matching cities, sorted by continent, country and name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--locations))

<a id="nestedatt--locations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `locations`

Read-Only:

- `continent` (String) Continent (region) name.
- `country` (String) Country name.
- `country_id` (Number) Country id (for `location_target_type = "COUNTRY"`).
- `id` (Number) City id.
- `name` (String) City name.
